card.name: Start of overdose management advice
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation right after overdose or overdosage in management sections, such as "no" before "specific antidote" or the comma before "general supportive measures". Also fires partway through drug names inside overdose management text.

modes.label: Just after overdose wording
modes.description: The word or comma that follows overdose or overdosage and leads into the treatment advice.
modes.example: As in any case of overdose<<,>> general supportive measures should be utilized.

modes.label: No specific antidote
modes.description: The word "no" opening the statement that no specific antidote exists.
modes.example: 10.2 Management of Overdosage<< No>> specific antidotes for desvenlaf

modes.label: Inside drug name in overdose text
modes.description: Partway through a drug name while overdose management is being discussed.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about death, suffocation and emergency rescue, so it adds a sense of severe overdose consequences.
card.plain: It lights up in overdose sections just where the text turns to how the overdose is managed, such as saying there is no specific antidote.
